This page is generated from the `tools/list` response of [s1000d-brex-mcp](/s1000d-stack/mcp/brex-mcp/) 0.8.1. The s1000d-brex-mcp page explains the configuration and how to read the responses.

## Summary

Lists the rules of a BREX. Returns the target (XPath), whether it may be used, the allowed values and their meaning, the severity level and the schemas the rule applies to. Narrow the list with `kind` (structure / notation / nonContext), `context` (schema name) and `search` (a string), and read it in parts with `offset` and `limit`

## Description returned by `tools/list`

This is the text an LLM receives.

> List the rules of a BREX data module in readable form: for each rule, the target (XPath), whether it is forbidden / required / optional, the allowed values with their meanings, severity, and the schema context it applies to. Also returns the BREX header (DMC, parent BREX, counts). Use "kind" and "context" to narrow, "offset"/"limit" to page.

## Arguments

The content of `inputSchema`. A nested argument is written as `parent.child`, and an item of an array as `parent[].child`.

| Name | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `brex` | `string` |  |  | Which BREX to use: a file path to a BREX data module (.xml), or a DMC (e.g. "KENBAIKI-A-00-00-00-00A-022A-D", "DMC-" prefix optional) searched in csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR / S1000D_SPEC_DIR. Omit to use the S1000D default BREX found under S1000D_SPEC_DIR. |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | CSDB folders to search for BREX by DMC (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; S1000D_SPEC_DIR is always searched for the S1000D default BREX). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `kind` | `string` |  | `all` / `structure` / `notation` / `nonContext`, default `"all"` | Rule kind to list (default: all). |
| `context` | `string` |  |  | Only rules that apply to this schema (file name such as "descript", "proced", "pm") plus the common rules. Omit for all contexts. |
| `search` | `string` |  |  | Case-insensitive text to find in objectPath, objectUse, rule id or value meanings. |
| `offset` | `number` |  | default `0` | Index of the first rule to return (default 0). |
| `limit` | `number` |  | default `50` | Maximum rules to return (default 50, max 500). |
